To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) commonsense knowledge can be used effectively to augment end-to-end dialog systems; (2) the knowledge-augmentation is more useful in retrieval-based models than in sequence-to-sequence models; and (3) the knowledge-augu- mented models are superior to the knowledge-free models in automatic evaluation.

(i) the knowledge-augmentated models outperform the knowledge-free ones, in both retrieval and generative settings; and (ii) the knowledge-augu-mented models are more effective in handling out-of-domain responses.

(1) integrating commonsense knowledge improves the performance of retrieval-based models in open domain conversation and (2) the knowledge-augmentation is most effective in the context of the conversation.
